problems.context: Call Stack vs Microtasks vs Macrotasks
problems.prompt: Determine the order of console output when the following JavaScript code runs to completion. Trace the Call Stack, Microtask Queue, and Task Queue.
problems.inputHint: e.g. A, B, C, D, E (comma or newline-separated)
problems.checkpointHint: Differentiate the synchronous execution phase from the Microtask queue, then the Macrotask queue.

steps.explain: Top-level statements execute first synchronously. console.log(1) runs immediately, setTimeout schedules a Macrotask, Promise.resolve().then schedules a Microtask, queueMicrotask schedules another Microtask, and console.log(500) runs on the Call Stack.
Once the Call Stack empties, the engine flushes all pending Microtasks in FIFO order: Promise.then logs 300, then queueMicrotask logs 4.
Only after the Microtask Queue is completely drained does the event loop pick the next Macrotask from the Task Queue: the setTimeout callback logs 2.
